from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486302/attempts/db4e56d7e3694d8caea4d8353ff4c479/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 2]
    rows = {}
    for r, c in markers:
        rows.setdefault(r, []).append(c)
    backbone_row = next(r for r, cols in rows.items() if len(cols) >= 2)
    cols = rows[backbone_row]
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
    for c in range(left, right + 1):
        if out[backbone_row][c] == 0:
            out[backbone_row][c] = 3
    for r, c in markers:
        if r == backbone_row:
            continue
        step = 1 if backbone_row > r else -1
        for rr in range(r + step, backbone_row, step):
            if out[rr][c] == 0:
                out[rr][c] = 3
    return out
'''
